name: Bestow Curse
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Lore vs Spirit against a creature you touch. On a win, choose a curse effect:

  • Choose a skill. The creature's rolls for that skill are ill-favored.

  • All the creature's attack rolls against you are ill-favored.

  • The creature takes -1 half action.

  • All your attacks against the target deal an additional 1d8 damage.

The creature knows you are the one who cursed it.

Describe the curse's effects.
